title: Final Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the scattering cross section must be correctly stated as sigma = 4 pi (2 m a^3 V_0 / 3 hbar^2)^2.

title: Partial Wave Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the s partial wave contribution and the relevant equations for low energy scattering.

title: Born Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of the scattering amplitude using the Born approximation must be correctly outlined.

title: Continuity Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The continuity conditions at r = a should be correctly applied to find the phase shift delta_0.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final expressions will lead to a deduction of points.
